harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The preposition phrase «في غَفْلَةٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) khabar (predicate); «مُعْرِضُونَ» is a second khabar, and the clause «وَهُمْ في غَفْلَةٍ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النَّاسِ».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «ما يأتِيهِم من ذِكْرٍ» is resumptive; «ذِكْرٍ» is the fāʿil (agent) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition phrase «من ربِّهِم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذِكرِ»; «مُحْدَثٍ» is a naʿt of «ذكر»; the clause «اسْتَمَعُوهُ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «يأتيهم»; the clause «وَهُمْ يلْعَبُونَ» is a ḥāl of the agent of «استمعوه».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «لاهِيَةً» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يلعبون», and «قُلوبُهم» is a fāʿil governed by «لاهية». «الذين» is a badal (substitute) of the wāw in «أَسَرُّوا». «بَشَرٌ» is the khabar (predicate) of «هذا», and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «مِثْلُكُمْ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بَشَر», and it did not acquire definiteness from the annexation because it is utterly vague. The clause «هل هذا إلا بَشَرٌ» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an omitted verb of saying which is a ḥāl of the wāw, i.e.: قائلين (saying). The clause «وأنتم تُبْصِرُونَ» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «تَأْتُونَ», and the clause «أَفَتَأْتُونَ» is conjoined to the object of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The preposition phrase «في السَّماءِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «القول»; the clause «وهو السَّمِيعُ» is conjoined to the clause «رَبِّي يعلمُ», and «العَليمُ» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); «أَضْغَاثُ» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). The fāʾ in His saying «فَلْيَأْتِنَا» links to the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: إن كان صادقًا فليأتنا (if he is truthful, let him bring us); the lām is the lām of command, and «يأتِنا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. The kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), i.e.: let him bring us a bringing like the sending of the former ones. The clause «أُرْسِلَ» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «قَرْيَةٍ» is the fāʿil (agent), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «أَهْلَكْنَاهَا» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause «أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «آمَنَتْ».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «رِجَالا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause «نُوحِي» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause «فَاسْأَلُوا» is resumptive; the clause «إنْ كُنْتُم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «جَسَدًا» is the second object; the clause «لا يَأْكُلُونَ» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause «وما كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما جعلناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «الوَعْدَ» is the second object; «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «أنجيناهم», and the clause «وَأَهْلَكْنَا» is conjoined to the clause «أنجيناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «لَقَدْ أَنزلْنَا» is the response to the oath, and the implied (muqaddar) oath clause is resumptive. The clause «فيه ذِكْرُكُمْ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتابًا», and the clause «تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «كَمْ» is the predicative (khabariyya) kam, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; the preposition phrase «مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كَمْ»; the clause «كانت» is a naʿt of «قَرْيَةٍ»; «آخَرِينَ» is a naʿt of «قَوْمًا».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوا» is conjoined to the clause {قَصَمْنَا}; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is the clause «إذا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ», and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the preposition phrase «مِنْها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «لا تَرْكُضُوا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied (muqaddar) verb of saying. «ما» is a nominal relative in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ارْجِعُوا», and «مَسَاكِنِكُم» is a noun conjoined to «ما». The clause «لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْألُونَ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «يَا وَيْلَنَا»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, and its clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb); the clause «إنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِين» is the response to the vocative, resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «دَعْوَاهُمْ» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما زال». «حتى» is a particle of limit and a preposition, and the maṣdar «أن جعلناهم» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (دَعْوَاهُم). «حصيدا» is the second object, and «وخامِدِين» belongs to the category of multiple objects, because the two objects are originally a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. «حَصِيدًا» means "reaped" (maḥṣūdīn), the implied form being: like a reaped crop; that is why it was not made plural.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The adverb «بَيْنَهُمَا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); «لاعِبِينَ»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun «نا» in «خَلَقْنَا».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: (لو أردنا أن نتخذ لهوا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «لَدُنْ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اتخذناه». The clause «إن كُنَّا فَاعِلِين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «بَلْ نَقْذِفُ» is resumptive. The clause «فَيَدْمَغُهُ» is conjoined to the clause «نَقْذِفُ»; the fāʾ in «فإذا» is a conjunction and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause «فإذا هو زَاهِقٌ» is conjoined to the clause «يَدْمَغُهُ». The clause «وَلَكُمُ الْوَيْلُ» is resumptive. His saying «مما» is composed of the preposition «مِنْ» and the maṣdariyya «مَا», and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «وَلَهُ مَنْ» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and «مَنْ» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «في السَّماوَات» is attached to the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause). The clause «وَمَنْ عِنْدَهُ لا يستكبرون» is conjoined to the resumptive one, «ولَهُ منْ في السَّماوات»; the relative noun «مَنْ» is a mubtadaʾ, the adverb «عنده» is attached to the ṣila, and the clause «لا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «مَنْ».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «يُسَبِّحُونَ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ», and the clause «لا يَفْتُرُونَ» is a ḥāl of the agent of «يُسَبِّحُون».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أَمْ» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) am, meaning bal plus the hamza; the preposition phrase «مِنَ الأرْضِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اتَّخَذَ» in the sense of "made", and the clause «هُمْ يُنْشِرُونَ» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «آلهة».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: (لو كان فيهما آلهة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition phrase «فِيهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and «آلهة» is its noun. His saying «إلا الله» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «آلهة». His saying «فَسُبْحَانَ»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «رَبِّ» is a badal (substitute). His saying «عمَّا» is composed of the preposition «عن» and the maṣdariyya «ما», and the maṣdar «عن وصفهم» (above their describing) is attached to the implied verb «نسبِّح» (we glorify); the clause «يَصِفُونَ» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «لا يُسْأَلُ» is resumptive, and the clause «وهم يُسْألُونَ» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «أَمْ» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) am; the preposition phrase «مِنْ دُونهِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «آلهة» is the first object. «هَاتُوا» is an imperative verb with its fāʿil (agent). The clause «هذا ذِكْرُ» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مَعِيَ» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); «قَبْلِي» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to the ṣila. The clause «بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ» is resumptive, and the clause «فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «لا يَعْلَمُونَ».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: His saying «رَسُولٍ»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «نُوحِي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «أَرْسَلْنَا», and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «نوحي». «إِلا أَنَا»: a particle of restriction, and a badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause of divine transcendence (jumlat al-tanzīh) is the khabar of «أَنَّ». The clause «فَاعْبُدُونِ» is conjoined to the khabar clause; the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ in «فاعْبُدُونِ» is the object of the verb, and the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The second object of «اتَّخَذَ» is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: from among the angels. «عِبادٌ» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هم (they). The clause (نُسَبِّحُ سُبْحَانَهُ) is resumptive, and so is the clause «بل هم عباد».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «لا يَسْبِقُونَهُ» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «عِبادٌ»; the preposition phrase «بالقول» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «وهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «هُمْ عِبَادٌ».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «يَعْلَمُ» is a third naʿt (adjective); the adverb «بَيْنَ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the clause «ولا يَشْفَعُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «يعلم»; the preposition phrase «مِنْ خَشْيَتِهِ» is attached to the khabar (predicate), and the clause «وهم مُّشْفِقُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «ولا يَشْفَعُونَ».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «وَمَن يَقُلْ» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «مِنْهُمْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يَقُلْ»; the clause «يَقُلْ» is the khabar (predicate) of the conditional mubtadaʾ (subject) «مَنْ»; the preposition phrase «مِنْ دُونِهِ» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «إِلَهٌ»; and the clause «فَذَلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The kāf in «كذلك» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being: نجزي الظالمين جزاءً مثل ذلك الجزاء (We recompense the wrongdoers a recompense like that recompense); the clause «نجزي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «أَوَلَمْ يَرَ» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of yarā. The clause «وَجَعَلْنَا» is conjoined to the clause «فَتَقْنَا», and the clause «أَفَلا يُؤْمِنُونَ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «رَوَاسِيَ» is the first object of «جَعَلْنَا», and the preposition phrase «في الأرْضِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The interpreted maṣdar «أَنْ تَمِيدَ» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear that it should shake. The preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to the second object; «سُبُلا» is a badal (substitute) of «فِجَاجًا»; the clause «لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase «عن آيَاتِهَا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive; the clause «كُلٌّ في فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the preceding nouns; the preposition phrase «في فلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and the tanwīn of «كُلٌّ» is a compensation for a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «وما جَعَلْنَا» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لِبَشَرٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object; the preposition phrase «مِنْ قَبْلِكَ» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بَشَرٍ». The condition and the interrogative come together in His saying «أَفَإِنْ مِتَّ», and the condition was answered in His saying «فهم الخَالِدُونَ»; the clause «أفإن مِتَّ» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «ذَائِقَةُ» is the khabar (predicate) of «كُلُّ»; the clause «وَنَبْلُوكُمْ» is conjoined to the resumptive one; His saying «فِتْنَةً» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and the clause «تُرْجَعُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «نبلوكم».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. His saying «إن يَّتَخِذُونَكَ»: «إن» is negating, and an imperfect verb in the nominative, its fāʿil (agent), its first object, and its second object: «هُزُوًا». Here «إذا» differs from the conditional particles, since when these particles are answered with «ما» or the negating «إنْ», the fāʾ must be brought, as in: إنْ درست فما أخطأت (if you studied, then you did not err), whereas you say: إذا درست ما أخطأت (when you studied, you did not err). The clause «أهذا الذي» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied (muqaddar) verb of saying, i.e.: يقولون (they say). This implied element is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «يَتَّخِذُونَكَ», i.e.: قائلين (saying). The clause «وهم بذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ هم كَافِرُونَ» is a ḥāl of the agent of «يَتَّخِذُونَكَ»; the second «هم» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the first, and «كافرون» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition phrase «مِنْ عَجَلٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الإنْسَان»; the clause «سَأُرِيكُمْ» is resumptive, and the clause «فَلا تَسْتَعْجِلُون» is conjoined to the clause «سَأُرِيكُم». «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is the object of the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «متى» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) khabar (predicate); «هذا» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الوَعْدُ» is a badal (substitute). The conditional clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: (لو يعلم الذين كفروا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: they would not have sought to hasten the punishment. «حين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «علموا» and not an adverb, i.e.: if they knew the time when the Fire is not held back. The clause «لا يَكُفُّونَ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «ولا هُم يُنْصَرُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «لا يَكُفُّونَ».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «بَلْ تَأْتِيهِمْ» is resumptive; «بَغْتَةً» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun of the Hour. The clause «فَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «تَبْهَتُهُمْ», and the clause «ولا هم يُنْظَرُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ» is resumptive, and the clause «اسْتُهْزِئَ» is the response to the oath. The preposition phrase «بِرُسُلٍ» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition phrase «مِنْ قَبْلِكَ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رسل»; the clause «فَحَاقَ» is conjoined to the clause «اسْتُهْزِئَ»; and His saying «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «حَاقَ».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يَكْلَؤُكُمْ» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. His saying «بَلْ هُم مُّعْرِضُونَ»: a particle of digression (iḍrāb), a mubtadaʾ and a khabar; the preposition phrase «عن ذكر» is attached to the khabar. The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «أَمْ» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) am, meaning bal plus the hamza. The clause «تَمْنَعُهُمْ» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause «لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تمنعهم», and the clause «وَلا هُمْ يُصْحَبُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «لا يستطيعون».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The maṣdar «حتى أن طال» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مَتَّعْنَا». The clause «أَفَلا يَرَوْنَ» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أنَّا نَأْتي» is the object of «يَرَوْنَ»; the clause «نَنْقُصُهَا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «نأتي»; and the clause «أَفَهُمُ الْغَالِبُون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «ولا يسمع» is resumptive, and the clause «يُنْذَرُونَ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إذا» is a pure adverb (ẓarf), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُم» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «مِنْ عذابٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نَفْحَةٌ». The lām occurs in the response to the oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped; the implied (muqaddar) wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis (tawkīd). The clause «لَيَقُولُنَّ» is the response to the oath, and the clause «إِنَّا كُنَّا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The preposition phrase «لِيَوْمِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نضع»; the clause «فلا تُظْلَمُ» is conjoined to the clause «نضع», and the clause «وإِنْ كان مِثْقَالَ» is conjoined to the clause «نضع». His saying «وكَفَى بنا حَاسِبِين»: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the pronoun «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and «حاسبين» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «ولقد آتينا» is resumptive; «الفُرْقَانَ» is the second object; the preposition phrase «لِلمُتَّقِين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «للمتقين»; the preposition phrase «بِالْغَيْبِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent); the clause «وَهُم مُّشْفِقُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «يَخْشَوْنَ», and the preposition phrase «مِنَ السَّاعَةِ» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «مشفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «أنزلناهُ» is a second naʿt (adjective), and the clause «أَفَأَنْتُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ» is conjoined to the clause «هذا ذِكْرٌ».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ولقد آتينا» is conjoined to the clause «لقد آتينا» in verse (48); the preposition phrase «من قَبْلُ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آتَيْنَا», and the clause «كُنَّا» is conjoined to the clause «آتَيْنَا».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «إذ» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) {آتَيْنَا}. His saying «ما هذه التَّمَاثِيلُ»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the demonstrative is its khabar (predicate); «التماثيل» is a badal (substitute), the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective), and the preposition phrase «لها» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «عَابِدِينَ» is the second object, and the preposition phrase «لها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عَابِدِين».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «أنتم» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the nominative pronoun in «كنتم», and «آباؤكم» is conjoined to the tāʾ; conjoining an overt noun to a nominative pronoun is permitted because of the presence of a separator. The clause «لقد كنتم» is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the oath clause with its response is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb).

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «أَمْ أَنْتَ مِنَ الَّلاعِبِين» is conjoined to the clause «جِئْتَنَا».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رَبُّ». The clause «وَأَنَا على ذَلِكُمْ من الشَّاهِدِين» is conjoined to the clause «رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ». The maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), its implied form being: لا يَصِحُّ ذلك (that is not right), and the clause «بل ربُّكم ربُّ» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The «wāw» is a conjunction, and the «tāʾ» is a particle of oath and a preposition; the genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) «أُقْسِمُ» (I swear). The clause «وأقسم بالله» is conjoined to the clause {رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ}. The clause «تُوَلُّوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and the maṣdar «أَنْ تُوَلُّوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مُدْبِرِينَ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «جُذَاذًا» is the second object; «إلا» is a particle of exception; «كَبيرًا» is the excepted; the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كبيرًا». The clause «لَعَلَّهُم يَرجِعُون» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase «إليه» is attached to «يرجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «إِنَّهُ لَمِن الظَّالمين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «يَذْكُرُهُمْ» is a naʿt (adjective), the clause «يُقَالُ» is a second naʿt, and «إبراهيم» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The fāʾ in «فَأْتُوا» links to the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: إن كان كذلك فأتوا (if it is so, then bring), and this implied element is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). The preposition phrase «على أَعْيُنِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «به», and the clause «لعلهم يشهدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «هذا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «يا إبراهيم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: I did not do it; the clause «بل فَعَلَه» is resumptive. His saying «هذا»: a naʿt (adjective) interpreted as a derived word, i.e.: the one pointed to. The clause «فَاسْأَلوهم» is conjoined to the clause «فعله كَبِيرهُم»; the clause «إِنْ كانوا يَنطِقُون» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «فَرَجعُوا» is resumptive; «أنتم» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf, and «الظالمون» is the khabar (predicate) of inna.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clause «لقد عَلِمْتَ» is the response to an implied (muqaddar) oath, and the oath clause with its response is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied verb of saying that is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: قائلين والله لقد عَلِمْتَ (saying: by Allah, you have known). The clause «ما هؤلاء يَنْطِقُونَ» stands in place of the two objects of ʿalima, and the clause «ينطقون» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: أتخطئون؟ (do you err?). The clause «فَتَعْبُدُونَ» is conjoined to the implied object of the speech; the preposition phrase «مِنْ دُونِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the following «ما», and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «شيئًا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a benefit, little or much.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: «أُفٍّ» is a verbal noun with the force of an imperfect verb (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ), meaning: I am vexed; the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أُفٍّ». The preposition phrase «مِن دُونِ» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied (muqaddar) object of «تعبدون». The clause «أف لكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; the clause «تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «إن كنتم فاعلين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: «كُوني» is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, with its noun and its khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «على إبراهيم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «سلامًا».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «كَيْدًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «الأخسرين» is the second object of «جعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «لُوطًا» is a noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «نَجَّيْنَاهُ»; «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الأرض»; and the two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The preposition phrase «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «نَافِلَةً» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يعقوب». His saying «وكُلا»: the wāw is a conjunction; «كلا» is the first object, placed first; «صالحين» is the second object of «جعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «أَئِمَّةً» is the second object, and the clause «يَهْدُونَ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أئمة»; the clause «وكانوا» is conjoined to the clause «أَوْحَيْنَا».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: His saying «وَلُوطًا»: the wāw is resumptive, and «ولوطًا» is the object of an omitted verb explained by what follows; the clause of the implied (muqaddar) verb is resumptive, and the clause «آتيناه» is explicative of it. «حُكْمًا» is the second object; «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «القرية»; the clause «إنهم كانوا» is resumptive; «فاسقين» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The preposition phrase «في رحمتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «إنه من الصالحين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أدخلناه».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: His saying «ونوحًا»: conjoined to «لوطًا». «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «نُوحًا». «وأهله» is a noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «نجَّيناه».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The verb «نصرناه» includes the meaning of «عصمناه» (We protected him), so it was made transitive in the way that one is. «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «القوم»; the clause «إنهم كانوا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ» is resumptive; the clause «فأغرقناهم» is conjoined to the clause «كانوا»; «أجمعين» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «داود»: a noun conjoined to «نوحًا» in verse (76). The first «إذ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «داود وسليمان», and the second «إذ» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحكمان»; the clause «نَفَشَتْ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وكنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the alif in «يحكمان». The lām in «لحكمهم» is redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening (taqwiya); «حكمهم» is the object of «شاهدين», and «شاهدين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنا».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا» is conjoined to the clause {يَحْكُمَانِ}; «سليمان» is the second object. His saying «وكلا»: the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause «آتينا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items; «كلا» is an object placed first, and «حكمًا» is the second object of «آتينا». «مع» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «يُسَبِّحْنَ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الجبال», and the clause «وكُنَّا» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «سخَّرنا».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «صَنْعة» is the second object; the preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «لَبُوسٍ»; the genitive maṣdar in «لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ» is attached to «علَّمناه»; and the clause «فهل أنتم شاكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: His saying «ولِسُليمان الرِّيحَ»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: سخَّرنا (We subjected); «الريح» is the object of the implied verb. «عاصِفة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الريح», and the clause «تجري» is a second ḥāl of «الريح». The implied clause «وسَخَّرْنَا» is conjoined to the clause «علَّمناه». The preposition phrase «بأمره» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تجري», i.e.: being accompanied. The clause «وكنا» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in the implied «سخَّرْنا».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The preposition phrase «ومن الشَّيَاطين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the preceding implied (muqaddar) verb «سخَّرنا»; «مَنْ»: a relative noun conjoined to the preceding {الرِّيحَ}, i.e.: and We subjected to him those who dive for him. «دُونَ» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «عملا»; the clause «وكنَّا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يعملون»; and the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «حافظين».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: His saying «وأَيُّوبَ»: a noun conjoined to «نوحًا» in verse (76). «إذ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «أيوب». The interpreted maṣdar «أَني مَسَّنِيَ» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ, and the clause «وأنت أرحم الراحمين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ in «مسَّني».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The preposition phrase «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the preposition phrase «مِنْ ضُرٍّ» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». «معهم» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to a ḥāl of «مثلهم», and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it. «رحمةً» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition phrase «من عندنا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; «وذِكرى» is a noun conjoined to «رحمة»; and the preposition phrase «للعابدين» is attached to a naʿt of «ذِكرى».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: His saying «وإسماعيل»: conjoined to «أيُّوبَ» in verse (83). «كُلٌّ» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the tanwīn is a compensation for a single word, i.e.: وكلهم (and all of them). The clause «كُلٌّ من الصابرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the aforementioned prophets.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «إنهم من الصالحين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أدخلناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «ذا النُّون» is a noun conjoined to «إسماعيل»; «إذ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «ذا النُّونِ». «أَنْ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha), lightened (mukhaffafa), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the maṣdar stands in place of the two objects, and the clause «لن نَقْدِرَ» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنْ». The clause of divine transcendence (jumlat al-tanzīh) is explicative of the calling, and the clause «سبحانك» is resumptive. «أنت» is a badal of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar, and the clause «إني كنت» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: His saying «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: ننجِّي المؤمنين إنجاءً مثل ذلك الإنجاء (We save the believers a saving like that saving). The clause «ننجي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «وزكريا»: a noun conjoined to «ذا النُّونِ»; «إذ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «زكريا». The clause «ربِّ لا تذرني» is explicative of the calling; «فردًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ. The clause «لا تَذَرْني» is the response to the vocative, and the clause «وأنت خير» is a ḥāl of the yāʾ in «لا تَذَرْنِي».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «إنهم كانوا» is resumptive; «رَغَبًا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «وكانوا» is conjoined to the clause «كانوا يُسَارِعُونَ».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «والتي» is a relative noun conjoined to «زكريا» in verse (89); «وابْنَها» is a noun conjoined to the pronoun hāʾ in «جعلناها»; the preposition phrase «للعالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «أُمَّتُكُمْ» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «أُمَّةً» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أمتكم». The clause «وأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ» is conjoined to the resumptive one, «إن هذه أمتكم», and the clause «فَاعْبُدُونِ» is conjoined to the clause «أنا ربكم». The implied (muqaddar) yāʾ in «اعبدون» is the object of the verb, and the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya).

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «بَيْنَهُمْ»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the verb includes the meaning of «قطعوا» (they cut). «كل» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «إلينا» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «راجعون»; and the clause «كل إلينا راجعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ» is conjoined to the resumptive one, {كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ}. «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «من الصالحات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعمل»; the clause «فلا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the clause «وإنا له كاتبون» is conjoined to the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «وَحَرَامٌ»: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «على قرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حرام», and beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it is qualified. The clause «أهلكناها» is a naʿt of «قرية». «حرام» means "obligatory", as in: {قُلْ تَعَالَوْا أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَلا تُشْرِكُوا}, and abandoning polytheism is obligatory. The maṣdar «أنهم لا يرجعون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. Ibn ʿAbbās said in explaining the verse: «واجب على قرية أهلكناها أنه لا يرجع منهم راجع» (it is obligatory upon a town We destroyed that none of them returns).

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); «إذا» is a conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis, and the conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «فُتِحَتْ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «وهم من كل حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition phrase «من كل حدب» is attached to the verb «ينسلون».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «واقْتَرَبَ الوَعْدُ» is conjoined to the clause {فُتِحَتْ}. The clause «فإذا هي شَاخِصَةٌ أَبصارُ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the preceding condition introduced by the conditional «إذا», and the clause «شاخصة أبصار» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هي». The fāʾ in «فإذا» links the apodosis, and the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya) reinforces the linking of the apodosis. «هي» is the pronoun of the story (ḍamīr al-qiṣṣa), mubtadaʾ; «شاخصة» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أبصار»; «الذين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «يا ويلنا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied (muqaddar) verb of saying, i.e.: يقولون (they say), and the implied clause of saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «كفروا». The clause «قد كنَّا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «بل كنا ظالمين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to the kāf; the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied (muqaddar) referent pronoun, i.e.: ما تعبدونه كائنًا من دون (what you worship, being other than…). The clause «أنتم واردون» is a ḥāl of «جهنم»; a ḥāl may come from the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) here because the muḍāf is like a part of the muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: (لو كان هؤلاء آلهة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «ما وَرَدُوهَا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the clause «وكل فيها خالدون» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The clause «لهم فيها زَفِير» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached; «زفير» is mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «وهم فيها لا يسمعون» is conjoined to the resumptive one, and the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the mubtadaʾ «هم».

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «سبقت», and the clause «أولئك عنها مُبْعَدُونَ» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «لا يسمعون» is a second khabar (predicate) of {إِنَّ}; the clause «وهم في ما اشْتَهَتْ أَنفسُهم خالدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يسمعون»; and the clause «اشتهت» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The clause «لا يَحْزُنُهُم الفَزَعُ» is a third khabar (predicate) of {إِنَّ}. The clause «هذا يَوْمُكُم» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied (muqaddar) verb of saying, i.e.: يقولون (they say), and the implied clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الملائكة».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: His saying «يوم»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: اذكر (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The kāf in «كَطَيِّ» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «طي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition phrase «للكتب» is redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening (taqwiya). The kāf in «كما» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq, and «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), i.e.: We will repeat it a repeating like Our beginning first. The clause «نعيده» is resumptive. «وَعْدًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e.: نَعِدُ وعدًا (We promise a promise), and the clause is resumptive; the preposition phrase «علينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (ṣifa) of «وعدًا»; and the clause «إنا كنَّا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «كتبنا», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن الأرض يرثها» is the object of «كتب».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: The preposition phrase «لِقَوْمٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بلاغًا».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The clause «وما أرسلناك» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلاغًا}; «رحمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition phrase «للعالَمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أَنَّمَا إلَهُكم إلهٌ واحدٌ» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause «فهل أنتم مسلمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The preposition phrase «على سَوَاءٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) and the object in «آذَنْتُكُم», i.e.: both being on equal terms. «إنْ» is negating, and the clause «إِنْ أَدْرِي» is conjoined to the clause «آذنتكم». The clause «أَقَرِيبٌ أم بعيدٌ ما تُوعَدُونَ» is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «أدري», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. «قريب» is a khabar (predicate) placed first; «أم» is a conjunction; «بعيد» is a conjoined noun; «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The preposition phrase «مِن القَوْلِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الجهر»; «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the maṣdar is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: what you conceal.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The clause «لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «أدري», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the expression of hope (tarajjī).

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: The clause «ورَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَنُ» is conjoined to the clause that is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb); «المستعان» is a second khabar (predicate); «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المُسْتَعَانُ».
